text:
Zoe: heads-up - small billing divergence in staging. late tail (~4m) caused compacted snapshot + late event to create an extra attribution path.
Rohan: can you show a minimal trace?
Zoe: event shape: `{"tenant":"acme","req_id":"r-500","tokens":16,"fp":"fp-500","ingest_ts":1688000000}` dedupe by fp+req upstream.
Priya: we've debated slop vs repairs a lot. new suggestion: what about a shadow-reconciler approach? keep realtime "provisional" ledger for dashboards, and a separate reconciled ledger built from compact+proofs that becomes authoritative after reconciliation.
Sam: tell me more - how would we flip authority without confusing customers?
Priya: workflow sketch: 1) ingest -> provisional credits applied to realtime ledger with tag `provisional_v{seq}`; 2) compactor produces compact snapshots + proofs; 3) reconciler consumes proofs and emits reconciled deltas to a dedicated topic `metering.reconciled`; 4) reconciled ledger advances a `final_seq` pointer per tenant; once final_seq passes a window, UI flips display from provisional->final for that window.
Zoe: so immediate dashboards keep low latency; billing/chargeable amounts only consider reconciled ledger after finalization. small deltas are handled via credit adjustments.
Rohan: that requires atomic flip semantics: when final_seq advances, we must emit an atomic delta event so downstream billing and invoices can apply idempotently. propose reconciled event: `{"type":"reconciled_window","tenant":"acme","window":"2026-03-22T11:00Z","seq":9876,"delta_tokens":-2,"proof":"s3://..."}`. finalizer consumes and applies CAS against `provisional_v{seq}`.
Sam: operationally neat - but we add more storage and an extra reconciler job. How long do we keep provisional data?
Priya: retention ideas: keep raw events 14d, provisional ledger entries 7d after finalization, proofs 30d. This lets us repair mid-term disputes and still bound storage.
Zoe: UX: show "provisional" badges in dashboard; add a toggle to view final-only. also surface "reconcile_rate" and an alert when reconcile deltas exceed threshold.
Rohan: edge cases: long-running requests spanning windows. canonical rule: provisional attributes to live window; reconciler can split/merge tokens during finalization but must attach `split_meta` so invoices remain explainable.
Sam: what about complexity of keeping two ledgers in sync during incidents? we need a fast reconcile loop and strong metrics to detect backlog. Also tenant throttling for reconciler to avoid IO storms.
Priya: agree. implement reconciler with per-tenant rate limits and graceful backpressure. keep reconciler stateless aside from final_seq per tenant in a small KV.
Zoe: action items: (1) Priya to draft reconciler event schema + finalizer CAS contract; (2) Rohan to prototype provisional tagging and UI flags; (3) Sam to spec retention and throttling; (4) Zoe to run a staging experiment enabling shadow reconcile for a subset of tenants.
billing-bot: branch `shadow-reconcile-proto` created and CI started (:rocket:)
Zoe: thanks all. this keeps latency for most users while giving us deterministic finalization for billing.
